name: TickTick
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For TickTick, combine tasks, habits, calendar, focus timer, and recurring reminders in one local app. The hard boundary is cross-platform sync, mobile widgets, calendar integrations, and years of recurrence polish, plus cross-device reliability and workflow polish.
